changelog: • User custom Entry, SL, and TP prices are strictly locked and preserved (never overwritten by live market ticks) • Staged orders with custom entry prices dispatch as limit_order at exact user entry price • Hero Lot Sizing Box is hidden by default when idle and appears only when trade staging is initiated • Completely eliminated dialog and launch lag by removing QGraphicsOpacityEffect offscreen rasterization overhead • Instant zero-delay settings modal open, close, and tab switching
